name: multi-language-compiler
description: Multi-Language Code Compiler and Evaluation Platform

scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npx concurrently "npm run build:frontend" "npm run build:backend" "npm run build:worker"
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.test: npx concurrently "npm run test:backend" "npm run test:frontend"
